title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing the authorization checks to be performed under that other client identity. This affects the client_credentials and password grant flows. The flaw arises because OAuthlib does not require the client_id in the request body to match the authenticated client's client_id before validating grant types and scopes. As a result, a lower-privilege client can obtain tokens with broader scopes or grant types assigned to a different client. A fix is available in version 11.0.3_1.
